meta_description: Renewable operators industrialize asset performance: turbine and inverter health, generation forecasting, PPA settlement and hybrid-plant optimization.

blocks.x: Renewable operators industrialize asset performance: turbine and inverter health, generation forecasting, PPA settlement and hybrid-plant optimization. Margins live in availability percentage points and forecast accuracy — both telemetry problems. This page is the operating picture: what runs, what strains, and which capabilities move the numbers that decide the margin.

The work concentrates in fleet maintenance, generation forecasting, ppa/go settlement, with hybrid optimization close behind. Volume grows on every path; the decision layer has not kept up. That gap is measurable, and it is the work.
Where the friction concentrates — Renewable Energy edition:

items: Turbines/inverters fail unscheduled; availability points lost.
Generation forecasts feed trading poorly; imbalance costs.
Technician routing and parts by spreadsheet; weather windows missed.
Settlement data assembly per contract; disputes slow.
Avoided-emissions claims unverified; buyers demand proof.
